services.description: Fargate services. path_patterns empty = no load balancer. secrets = names from secret_names.

deploy_role_name.description: The GitHub deploy role that gets permission to publish the site

domains.description: Addresses this site answers on. Empty = only the CloudFront address. Adding any is part of the DNS switch: Caleb's OK.

noindex.description: Tell search engines to skip this copy. True for anything that isn't homecookd.app.

alb_allowed_cidrs.description: Set to one address (x.x.x.x/32) for a real_ai window. Open otherwise, for the deploy's smoke test

dish_budget_usd.description: The dish ask's daily model budget on staging. Mom's answers may pass it by MOM_OVERAGE_USD, and calls in flight by more (DISH-MIGRATION.md)

real_ai.description: Real Claude and Cartesia, for a test window only: costs real money, capped by dish_budget_usd
